categories.name: Ear
categories.concept: Customizable, stackable earrings. One classic base stud in four shapes; cuffs and stack pieces mix and match into a curated piercing stack — the look of multiple piercings without the piercings.

components.name: Primary Stem Stud
components.function: Base piercing. Fixed stone in minimal prong or bezel setting. Anchors the modular system via its post.

components.name: Press-On Ear Cuff
components.function: Thick or thin non-piercing cuff with embedded focal stone. Wears without multiple piercings.

components.name: Detachable Drop Charm
components.function: Small key-loop stone drop — behind-ear or clips onto hoop. Interchangeable.

components.name: Orbit Hoop / Jacket
components.function: Semi-circle halo that attaches to the back of the stud post and drops below the lobe.

components.name: Linking Chain
components.function: Delicate chain with loops on both ends — threads onto stud post and loops onto cuff.

categories.name: Neck
categories.concept: Customizable layered stacks — chokers, lariats, long drops, and layering chains that mix and match. Layered jewellery made effortless, versatile, and individual.

components.name: Primary Pendant Necklace
components.function: Anchor piece: fixed stone pendant on chain.

components.name: Detachable Drop Charm
components.function: Slides onto N1 bail or clips onto chain — swap the pendant story.

components.name: Orbit Halo Jacket
components.function: Semi-circle frame that sits around primary pendant.

components.name: Linking Extender Chain
components.function: Converts lengths — choker to drop, short to lariat.

categories.name: Rings
categories.concept: Stackable rings styled across multiple fingers or worn as a full statement stack. Everyday-easy, plus playful pinky rings with cute colourful stones.

components.name: Detachable Shank Charm
components.function: Clips onto R1 band — adds a stone story to the stack.

components.name: Orbit Halo Jacket Band
components.function: Semi-circle halo that circles around R1.

components.name: Linking Stacker Band
components.function: Thin band designed to stack flush with R1.
